schema.description: Optional sourceId creates a new draft from a rejected record of the same kind. Source read and destination write permissions are required. The source remains immutable; provenance is stored transactionally in record.created audit.

get.summary: History of a single readable record
get.description: Up to 200 record events, oldest first. Malformed UUID returns 400; a missing record or a record outside the caller's domain read permission returns 404. actorName and actorRole reflect the actor's current account. Only whitelisted details are exposed; unrelated raw audit data and credentials are never returned.
